title: Color is not correct
text: Color is not correct. We have a black and white marble counter and I thought these would be close to perfect. However, the "white" part of the marbling in these mats is NOT white. It's a light blue. Be warned that if you are looking for black and white, this is not it. Also the fabric is thin and sleazy feeling.
